notes: All 25 candidates read in full from the saved text. Scope counts: program-list 3, single-record 0, not-a-list 22. Integrator notes: (1) The Imperial College London doctoral 'graduate placements' page (business-school/programmes/doctoral-degree/career-impact/graduate-placements) is marked not-a-list only because the saved capture text is cut off inside the navigation menu before the body; the URL is a genuine doctoral placement page and needs a full refetch rather than dismissal. (2) The two Kent State job-market pages are per-concentration pages of the College of Business Administration Ph.D. (Finance: 2 names; Management: 1 name) listing candidates and emails only, no placements; sibling pages for other concentrations likely exist. (3) The JHU Applied Mathematics and Statistics dissertation list covers the whole department (statistics, financial mathematics, discrete math, operations research and optimization); area must be classified per person, and it gives advisors and years but no placements. (4) Two name-bearing lists were excluded by department rule rather than content: Kent State Political Science placements and Kent State Cultural Foundations (education) dissertations. (5) The JHU Civil and Systems Engineering 'where are they now' page has positions without names and mixes master's and PhD alumni. No institution-by-host corrections were needed.
